text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"What happens twice will happen thrice"—I desperately didn't want to say that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—So, are you saying that due to injury, she will cancel her autumn starts
and take the rest of the year off entirely...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby, who competed with Ikuno Dictus
in the Japanese Oaks, withdrew from all remaining races
this year due to an injury—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, did you see this?
She's taking an indefinite break due to injury.
She did pretty well in the Oka Sho, too.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! We just had that whole thing with Daiichi Ruby, too.
Isn't that happening a bit too often lately?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There was also another serious injury
among the Umamusume who ran in the Oka Sho together—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus took the news of her peers heavily,
voicing her thoughts each time it happened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That "I will definitely run the Shuka Sho to the very end."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, I was still agonizing over whether running in the Shuka Sho was truly the right choice...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we are to err on the side of caution,
and ensure a path that lets her keep running for a long time,
there is merit in choosing to sit this race out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perfecting my physique with the time remaining this year so I can run without regrets in the Senior Class... That can't possibly be a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if one is to respect
Ikuno Dictus's wishes...
those choices become fundamentally incompatible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That would betray Ikuno Dictus's hard work, as well as her trust in me.
choice_data_list: (...Ah, I see... She's scared...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Whether to enter Ikuno Dictus into grueling races, or to suggest against it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I am terrified of both.
choice_data_list: (How... pathetic of me...)
(How... utterly pathetic...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Compared to Ikuno Dictus, I'm... so weak-willed. Such a coward.
—Hmm, you seem to be brooding quite a bit.
choice_data_list: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo~!
You're Ikuno-chan's Trainer, right?
choice_data_list: Aines Fujin...! Why—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was working my part-time job nearby and was just on my way back.
What a coincidence~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just so you know, this is part of resting too!
It doesn't put any strain on the body, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean—
More importantly, have you seen your face?
It looks like the end of the world.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Did something happen regarding Ikuno-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If I'm going to be seen through anyway,
it might be better to just take advantage of this coincidence.
choice_data_list: ...There's something I'd like to ask you.
...There's something I'd like to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Determined to reset my gridlocked thoughts,
I made up my mindâ

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe~ thanks for treating me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And? What was it
you wanted to ask me?
choice_data_list: …Please, let me apologize first.
…Let me apologize first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I was about to ask
would not be pleasant for her to hear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Because it might be an insult to her.
choice_data_list: Do you... regret it now...?
Do you... regret it right now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Let me ask you something instead.
Why did you think that
I might be regretting it?"
choice_data_list: That was... because it was magnificent—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The run Ines Fujin showed us at the Derby...
A brilliance that seemed to unleash the boundless potential of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The frenzy of the people entranced by that brilliance. The roaring voices calling out the victor's name—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of it... The Umamusume named Ines Fujin,
who stood at the center of it all...
was simply, truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because it was so truly magnificent—
choice_data_list: I just wanted to see you keep running longer.
I wanted you to keep running for longer

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A slight prickle stings the back of my nose, and my vision blurs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Surely these feelings aren't meant only for Ines Fujin."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: These feelings are dedicated to all the Umamusume who ran in this world and suddenly left the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now...
those feelings were overflowing into words, taking shape—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ――I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to win that day.
I wanted to run ahead of everyone else."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I put everything on the line.
I told myself, "I'm giving this everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because I knew that without that...
I wouldn't stand a chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And so, burning through everything I had, I won.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...It was amazing back then.
Just like you said, everything was shining."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so much so that it makes me think...
maybe I've been running all this time just to see this sight.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...From here on out, though,
it's just my personal opinion.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If the choice is between breaking past your limits and winning at the cost of an injury, or not getting hurt but losing—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Without hesitation, I choose victory.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Because I...
run races to win!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ines Fuujin's words were refreshingly straightforward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her choices, and the present they created, made me realize that this was something sacred—a domain where I had no right to intrude.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Still, you know. I am me. You are you.
And... Ikuno-chan is Ikuno-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Ikuno-chan has
choices of her own to make.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I haven't heard the full details of what's troubling you,
but I think that's probably
the single most important thing.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, you're right. Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ines Fuujin is right. As Ikuno Dictus's trainer, now is the time I must find out for sure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus's choice in the face of victory.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Even so, Ikuno-chan was totally right~.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I asked Ikuno-chan before, 'What kind of person is your Trainer?'

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And then, Ikuno-chan said this.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They called him "the person who cares about the future of Umamusume more than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ......Ready to go?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you've got a great look on your face now!
choice_data_list: Thank you, Ines Fujin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have to see Ikuno Dictus right now.
Driven by that urge, I kicked off the ground and ran—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ......Do your best.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: “――Yeah, totally! I want to race you with everything I've got someday too, Ikuno-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"‘So I'll look forward to it
in the future too!’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much.
...I am honored."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Though the promise we made for the future fell through.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: In return, at least this much should be... fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I open "IRON WILL" while running.
After checking Ikuno Dictus's self-training regimen, I accelerate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her, she'll stick to the schedule without fail
and be right where she's supposed to be—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
The next routine is—"
choice_data_list: —Ikuno!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Trainer-san?
What's the matter, why are you in such a rush—
choice_data_list: There's an important question I want to ask you right now...!
There's an important question I want to ask you... right now...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Let us hear it.
choice_data_list: If it's for the sake of victory, you would...
If it's for the sake of victory, you would—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Do I seize that glory even at the cost of everything?
Or do I give it up so that I can run for a long time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Which one will you choose?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I won't choose either of them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: There is still only one choice to make.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"To seize the glory of victory, and to run for a long time."
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—Running longer than anyone else,
stacking up more victories than anyone else.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely what I have arrived at—the ultimate 'objective' to prove my racing capabilities and everything Sensei taught me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. Ikuno Dictus had
already made her choice."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You chose the hardest path of all right from the very beginning, didn't you...?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, before I knew it, I had narrowed down
my own options within myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with one tragedy after another, I let my mind jump to the worst
and forgot what mattered most—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand it myself.
Just how difficult that truly is."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"However, I have no fear.
Nor do I believe it to be impossible to achieve."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The words you spoke to me that day.
What you said when you asked to be my Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Because that gave me courage... I can still keep moving forward now."
choice_data_list: Then I'll say it one more time, right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose sight anymore. I won't waver anymore.
I'll push forward without fear. My mind is set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With feelings stronger than back then, I renew my vow.
Like re-forging iron to make it stronger—
choice_data_list: —I'll make sure you keep running longer than anyone else.
—I'll make sure you can run longer than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I put it into words,
striving to embody an even firmer resolve
than Ikuno Dictus.
choice_data_list: And I'll make sure you win more than anyone else. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I will make sure to keep supporting Ikuno Dictus, no matter what lies ahead.
choice_data_list: Let's keep fighting, through the Shuka Sho and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I would love to, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The handshake we shared was firmer than that day's.
Firm enough to convince me that nothing could ever break it again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's start walking again from here.
Tracing a long path of hoofprints alongside Ikuno Dictus—
